verdict.rationale: PostHog offers a hosted, OAuth-gated MCP server (confirmed live by probe) whose tool inventory includes a Dashboards category of 18 tools alongside insight and query tools. Its first-party agents (PostHog AI and the AI wizard) are documented as creating dashboards and generating insights, so an agent can plausibly build a key-metrics dashboard end-to-end. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the dashboard/insight create-and-add MCP tools or API endpoints (only `dashboard-get` is named), and independent or hands-on corroboration of an external agent building a dashboard via MCP/API.
